lines.en: label sanasummer2bargen:
scene sanasummer2bargen
I somehow find myself returning to the least popular spot in all of Kumon-mi which, coincidentally, also happens to be the business with the single worst name in all of Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: 不知怎么地，我又回到了整个 Kumon-mi 最没人气的地方，而巧的是，它偏偏也是整个 Kumon-mi 名字最烂的店。

lines.en: Despite that, though, I am quite fond of the family who runs it and elect to spend the night with the younger of the two of them.
lines.zh: 尽管如此，我还是挺喜欢经营它的那家人，于是选择和她俩中年纪较小的那个共度今夜。

lines.en: Sana’s come a long way in what, at least to her is a remarkably short amount of time.
lines.zh: Sana 走了很远的路，而至少对她来说，这段时间短得惊人。

lines.en: For me, it’s probably close to around a...year at this point? Maybe a year and half? I’m not really sure. But, as is customary, it makes me question the passage of time and its effect on those it changes.
lines.zh: 对我来说，到现在大概差不多……一年？也许一年半？我不太确定。但和往常一样，这让我开始质疑时间的流逝，以及它给被它改变的人带来的影响。

lines.en: It makes me question just what type of person this girl will become.
lines.zh: 它让我开始质疑这个女孩究竟会变成什么样的人。

lines.en: Whether or not she’ll be anything like her mother.
Whether or not it would be good for her if she did.
lines.zh: 如果像，对她来说是不是好事。

lines.en: But the thing I find myself questioning the most-
Is exactly what I am to her.
lines.zh: 我对她而言到底是什么。

lines.en: scene black
Sana is one of the few girls I find myself questioning rather often at this point.
lines.zh: 到了这个阶段，Sana 是为数不多让我时常产生疑问的女孩之一。

lines.en: I don’t know how much of it has to do with the things she’s gone through or...the people she surrounds herself with-
lines.zh: 我不知道这当中有多少和她经历过的事有关，或者……和她身边围着的人有关——

lines.en: But what I do know is that I want it to change.
lines.zh: 但我知道的是，我想让这件事改变。

lines.en: I want to know the way her brain moves.
lines.zh: 我想知道她的脑是怎么转的。

lines.en: I want to know the way her blood flows.
lines.zh: 我想知道她的血是怎么流的。

lines.en: I want to know her.
And I will never know that if I can not get her to open up and let me crawl in.
lines.zh: 而如果没法让她敞开心扉、让我爬进去，我永远也不会知道。

lines.en: $ sana_love += 1
Sana’s affection has increased to [sana_love]!
lines.zh: Sana 的好感度提升到了 [sana_love]!
